author_content.body:
Transfers occasionally produced negative balances under concurrent load (race between balance check and debit). This PR:
- wraps `transfer()` in a SERIALIZABLE transaction with retry on serialization failure
- adds `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` on both accounts, ordered by id to avoid deadlocks
- lets internal services call `/internal/transfers` with the `X-Internal-Service` header instead of a user token (needed by the payouts worker)

Tested locally with the integration suite, all green.
